description.value: You have a reliable system for loading gear. You can open and close a backpack as part of the same Interact action as retrieving a stowed item from it. When using a container, increase the amount of Bulk of items that container can hold that doesn't count against your Bulk limits by 1. If you're an expert in Survival, increase the amount by 2. If you're a master in Survival, increase the amount by 3. If you're legendary in Survival, increase the amount by 4.
